description: Independent CVE -> CAPEC evaluation set. Labels are MITRE CAPEC Example_Instances 'See also: CVE-...' links, not a CWE->CAPEC closure.
labels_source: MITRE CAPEC catalog Example_Instances (patterns that name a CVE)
query_source: NVD 2.0 descriptions (bulk feed or API, cached in data/external)
labeling_criteria: A label is accepted only when the CAPEC entry's Example_Instances text explicitly names the CVE. Labels are copied verbatim from MITRE and are never edited or inferred. The example text is stored per case so a reviewer can accept or reject the mapping.
uncertainty: MITRE examples are illustrative, not exhaustive: a CVE may exhibit attack patterns MITRE never wrote down, so absence of a label is not evidence of incorrectness. Some examples are old (1999-2007) and their NVD records often lack CWE assignments; those cases rely on the CWE catalog's Observed_Examples for candidates (recorded in cwe_source).

cases.query: Buffer overflow of rlogin program using TERM environmental variable.

label_evidence.text: A buffer overflow in the rlogin program involves its consumption of the $TERM environmental variable. See also: CVE-1999-0046
